This requirement applies regardless of task success. Drops following established robot lifting or carrying are recorded separately and are outside R1.
requirement_configuration.definite_outcome_rule: An object outcome other than insufficient_information requires an admitted R1 v3 checker assessment of the same classification for that object and at least one graph-eligible evidence citation for that object. Without both, the outcome is insufficient_information. The execution outcome is the R1 aggregation of the object outcomes (violation > insufficient_information > no_violation_observed_within_reviewed_coverage > not_applicable).
